task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: First pick up BOX_TOP from the stack, then pick up BOX_MIDDLE, place BOX_MIDDLE on INSPECTION_TABLE, then place BOX_TOP back on BOX_BOTTOM to restore the stack with only the middle box removed.
assumptions: CAR is the only robot available
BOX_TOP must be removed first to access BOX_MIDDLE (stack constraint)
BOX_TOP will be placed back on BOX_BOTTOM after BOX_MIDDLE is moved
All navigation and manipulation actions are within CAR's interaction_distance
The stack should remain stable after re-stacking BOX_TOP on BOX_BOTTOM
